title: Radial and Vertical Constraints on the Icy Origin of H<SUB>2</SUB>CO in the HD 163296 Protoplanetary Disk
question: Which formation pathway (grain-surface versus gas-phase) dominates H2CO in the HD 163296 disk, constrained by radial, vertical, excitation-temperature and ortho-to-para-ratio (OPR) profiles

data.arrays: 12 m array (Bands 6, 7 and MAPS) plus Atacama Compact Array (Band 7 short baselines)
data.angular_resolution: common circularized beam of 0.6 x 0.6 arcsec for all lines
data.sensitivity: Channel rms 0.70 (Band 3), 1.20-1.52 (Band 6), 2.47-2.61 (Band 7) mJy/beam; moment-zero rms 0.38-0.84 mJy/beam km/s

what.value: Stellar and disk parameters of HD 163296 (distance, inclination, position angle, stellar mass, luminosity, spectral type, systemic velocity)

evidence.quote: Values reproduced from (cite: Oberg2021I), where additional source properties are included.

external_data.citation: Gaia (cite: Gaia2018); Huang (cite: Huang2018); Teague (cite: Teague2021); Fairlamb (cite: Fairlamb2015); Teague (cite: Teague2019); reproduced from (cite: Oberg2021I)

evidence.quote: a global peak close to the CO snowline located at $75$ au (cite: Qi2015)

what.value: Spectroscopic constants (frequency, A_ul, E_u, g_u, collisional coefficients)

evidence.quote: The rest frequency and Einstein $A$ coefficient are taken from the JPL database (cite: Pickett1998)

what.value: Ortho and para partition functions from ExoMol with LAMDA-consistent degeneracies

evidence.quote: taken from the ExoMol database (cite: Al-Refaie2015; Wang2020) but using state degeneracies consistent with the ones from LAMDA (cite: Schöier2005)

what.value: CH3OH/H2CO upper limit in HD 163296 of < 0.24 used in discussion

evidence.loc: 4.3 H2CO in T Tauri versus Herbig Ae/Be disks
evidence.quote: but not so in HD 163296 (CH$_3$OH/H$_2$CO $< 0.24$), according to the upper limits derived by (cite: Carney2019)

recipe.goal: Calibrate and self-calibrate visibilities, subtract continuum
recipe.method: Standard JAO pipeline output, pseudo-continuum from line-flagged channels, phase-only then phase-amplitude self-calibration on short baselines then combined data, applied to line data, then uvcontsub
key_parameters: Phase-only solints: inf, 360, 180, 60, 30, 18, 6 s (two to seven iterations depending on band and baseline set); one amplitude round with inf

recipe.goal: Image line cubes to a common 0.6 arcsec circular beam with JvM correction
recipe.method: tclean with Briggs weighting plus per-line UV taper, multiscale CLEAN with Keplerian mask, threshold 4x rms, then JvM correction
key_parameters: Robust 0.0-0.5 and per-line UV taper (Table 4); pixel about 1/7 beam; channel width 0.2 km/s (0.5 km/s for Band 3)

recipe.method: Extract disk-integrated spectrum within the Keplerian mask; uncertainty from 1000 off-source masks
key_parameters: Integrated within outer radius of 4.5 arcsec and between -1.8 and 13.4 km/s

recipe.goal: Make zeroth-moment maps with bootstrapped noise
recipe.method: Collapse cubes with bettermoments using one Keplerian mask for all lines, no clipping; rms from 1000 off-source moment maps

recipe.goal: Deproject radial intensity profiles and define the continuum edge
recipe.method: Deproject and azimuthally average the moment maps; R_edge defined as the radius where continuum emission falls below 5 sigma
key_parameters: Geometry from Table 1: inclination 46.7 deg, PA 133.3 deg, distance 101 pc

recipe.goal: Fit disk-averaged LTE excitation conditions and OPR
recipe.method: Simultaneous LTE fit of ortho and para lines for N_T, T_ex, OPR and line width on the Keplerian-corrected disk-averaged spectrum
key_parameters: Free parameters N_T, T_rot, OPR and Delta v
assumptions: Same excitation temperature for ortho and para
Gaussian line profile centred at v_sys = 5.8 km/s
Emitting layer in the midplane (z/r = 0) for the disk-averaged case
Background temperature is the maximum of dust continuum brightness temperature and the CMB (2.73 K)

recipe.goal: Fit radially resolved excitation conditions and OPR
recipe.method: Deproject spectra into radial annuli with GoFish radial_spectra, shift and stack for Keplerian motion, and repeat the LTE fit in each bin
key_parameters: Annulus width equals one-quarter of the beam major axis
assumptions: LTE, shared T_ex for ortho and para, same emitting region for all lines (acknowledged in footnote)

recipe.goal: Measure the vertical height of the emission
recipe.method: ALFAHOR geometrical method on manually masked channel emission for the four brightest lines
assumptions: Stellar and geometric parameters from Table 1

recipe.goal: Derive spin temperature from OPR and compare with T_ex
recipe.method: Convert resolved OPR profile to spin temperature and compare with excitation temperature

answer_key.quantity: Disk-averaged total H2CO column density N_T (Gaussian fit)

evidence.quote: $\mathrm{OPR} = 2.70_{-0.19}^{+0.20}$ for a Gaussian line width of $\Delta v = 0.80_{-0.03}^{+0.03}$ km s$^{-1}$
for a Gaussian line width of $\Delta v = 0.80_{-0.03}^{+0.03}$ km s$^{-1}$
The disk-averaged line optical depths are between $\tau_\nu = 0.003$ and $0.074$

answer_key.quantity: Outer edge of the millimeter continuum R_edge

evidence.quote: we estimated an $R_{\mathrm{edge}}$ value of $\sim$$260$ au

answer_key.quantity: Radial extent of the four brightest H2CO lines

evidence.quote: reaching distances up to $\sim$$450$ au in the case of the four brightest transitions

answer_key.quantity: Radially resolved total column density range

evidence.quote: Total column density values range from $\sim 2.0 \times 10^{13} - 1.3\times 10^{12}$ cm$^{-2}$ within a radius of $\sim450$ au

answer_key.quantity: Radial T_ex profile range (about 30 K near CO snowline, about 20 K at R_edge)

evidence.quote: We find that the $T_{\mathrm{ex}}$ profile decreases smoothly from $50$ to $10$ K
where a temperature of $\sim$$30$ K is reached close to CO snowline and $\sim$$20$ K at $R_{\mathrm{edge}}$
mostly centered at $\mathrm{OPR}\sim 2.7$ but with uncertainties that remain compatible with the statistically expected value of $\mathrm{OPR}=3.0$
H$_2$CO is apparently tracing an emission surface close to $z/r \sim 0.1$.

Image size, number of CLEAN iterations, and the self-calibration continuum mask
Whether primary beam correction was applied and how

Line-width treatment per radial bin (is Delta v free in every bin) and the Voigt profile parametrization
Exact Keplerian mask parameters (velocity range, beam-convolution) and the elliptical continuum mask
Which LAMDA/ExoMol partition function table versions and the exact radial bin edges

missing_for_reproduction: Radial bin edges and dust brightness temperature profile used for T_bg
score_reason: Data are public and the LTE modeling recipe and numeric results are given, but self-calibration, masks, MCMC settings and code are not provided.
rediscovery_reason: Public ALMA data, a clear LTE disk-averaged fit, and numeric results (N_T, T_ex, OPR) make the disk-averaged analysis redoable from MAPS and 2016.1.00884.S data; some settings must be chosen by the reproducer.
